title: 第13章 原来杨家也很强势第14章 下次记得下手狠点
slug: 无敌凡体以剑证道杀穿三千界
lines: 李轩回头看去，立即就看到一名中年男子阔步走了过来。
这中年男子面色阴沉，身上强大气息涌动，令得周围不少人都是面色煞白，纷纷后退。
“轮海境？”
李轩看着此人，瞳孔忍不住微微一缩。
他虽然修为不在，但眼力却还在。
李轩一眼便是已经看出，此人乃是一位轮海境一重修士，超越了先天的存在。
杨愈看到此人，面色也是忍不住大变，脱口道：“林家三爷，林长山？”
林长山却是根本就没有理会杨愈，他冷冷盯着李轩，身上那强大威压已经宛若排山倒海般压迫过来。
“年轻人，切磋而已，你竟下如此狠手，未免有些太过分了吧？”
那倒在地上的林川看到林长山出现，立即强忍着剧痛怒吼道，“三叔，给我杀了他，给我杀了他！”
由于嘴巴被抽烂，林川现在的声音听起来极为别扭。
他眼神怨毒的看着李轩，恨不得将李轩碎尸万段。
李轩看着林长山，不卑不亢道：“不好意思，我也没有想到，他竟然会那么弱。”
他们都很想问，你是认真的吗？都这种时候了，竟然还敢说这种风凉话？
林川更是气的差点没一口老血喷出来。
他弱吗？
好吧，在李轩面前，或许是真的弱了一些。
可这话有些刺耳，扎心啊。
他老脸火辣，恨不得去死，那眼神也是更加怨毒了。
林长山瞳孔也是忍不住微微一缩，其内涌现出了一抹杀机。
他也没有想到，李轩竟然这么带种，面对他这位轮海境，没有畏惧也就算了，竟然还敢如此狂妄。
李轩的表情却很是认真，“他先前那么高傲，修为又在先天境一重，我以为他很强，因此只能全力以赴。”
“但谁能想到，他竟然那么不堪，连我一拳都没有接住呢？我才炼气境九重啊，这真不能怪我。”
噗！
林川听到这话，终于是没有忍住，一口老血喷了出来。
那些围观众人在胆战心惊的同时，也是忍不住憋笑。
扎心啊！
而且这话说的还一点毛病没有。
林长山冷冷盯着李轩，眼中杀意也是更甚了，“我不管你出于什么原因，总之下手狠这是事实。”
“有些事情既然做了，那就要付出代价。既然你打烂了小川的嘴，还废掉了他一条手臂。”
“那我打烂你的嘴，废掉你四肢，应该不算过分吧？”
此言一出，全场哗然。
李轩眼神也是忍不住眯起。
他右手紧握在凡剑之上，体内灵气开始澎湃，已经做好了施展禁术一搏的准备。
任人鱼肉，那是不存在的，哪怕打不过，他也是要干的。
撇开曾经的身份不谈，现在的李轩也算是一名剑修，而身为剑修，那是要宁折不弯，一往无前的，又岂有弯腰之理？
林长山说着，轮海境强者的气息已经是爆发开来，同时挥手一巴掌朝着李轩的脸抽了过去。
浩瀚灵气涌动，掀起了轰鸣之音，轮海境强者哪怕只是随便的一掌，也绝对不是先天可比。
这里可是林家地盘，李轩竟然在这里当众抽了林川耳光，还废掉了林川手臂，这自然是没有办法忍的。
否则，身为五大家族之一的林家威严何在，岂不是要沦为笑柄？
“哈哈哈，林长山你这个不要脸的狗东西，竟然在众目睽睽之下对一个后辈出手，真是好大的威风啊！”
就在林长山的攻击即将落在李轩身上，李轩也即将施展禁术拼命一搏时，
content_en:
Li Xuan looked back and immediately saw a middle-aged man striding over.
The middle-aged man's face was gloomy, and a powerful aura surged from his body, causing many people around him to turn pale and retreat.
"Lun Hai Realm?"
Li Xuan looked at this person and his pupils couldn't help but shrink slightly.
Although his cultivation is no longer there, his eyesight is still there.
Li Xuan could tell at a glance that this person was a first-level monk in the Wheel Sea Realm, someone who transcended innate existence.
When Yang Yu saw this person, his expression couldn't help but change drastically, and he blurted out: "Third Master of the Lin family, Lin Changshan?"
Lin Changshan ignored Yang Yu at all. He stared at Li Xuan coldly, and the powerful pressure on his body was already overwhelming like an overwhelming force.
"Young man, it's just a discussion, but you're so cruel, isn't it a little too much?"
When Lin Chuan, who was lying on the ground, saw Lin Changshan appear, he immediately endured the severe pain and roared, "Third uncle, kill him, kill him!"
Lin Chuan's voice now sounds extremely awkward because his mouth was beaten to pieces.
He looked at Li Xuan with malicious eyes, wishing to cut Li Xuan into pieces.
Li Xuan looked at Lin Changshan and said neither humble nor arrogantly: "I'm sorry, I didn't expect him to be so weak."
Everyone: "···"
They all want to ask, are you serious? At this time, you still dare to say such sarcastic words?
Lin Chuan was so angry that he almost spit out a mouthful of blood.
Is he weak?
Well, maybe he is really weak in front of Li Xuan.
But these words are a bit harsh and heartbreaking.
His face was so hot that he wanted to die, and his eyes were even more vicious.
Lin Changshan's pupils couldn't help but shrink slightly, and a murderous intent emerged in them.
He also didn't expect that Li Xuan would be so arrogant. Facing him, who was in the Lunhai realm, it didn't matter if he didn't have any fear, but he would dare to be so arrogant.
Li Xuan's expression was very serious, "He was so arrogant before, and his cultivation was at the first level of the Xiantian realm. I thought he was very strong, so I had no choice but to go all out."
"But who would have thought that he would be so unbearable that he couldn't even catch my punch? I'm only at the ninth level of Qi Refining Realm, so you really can't blame me."
Everyone: "···"
Poof!
When Lin Chuan heard this, he finally couldn't hold it back and spurted out a mouthful of blood.
While the onlookers were frightened, they could not help but laugh.
It hurts my heart!
And there is nothing wrong with what he said.
Lin Changshan stared at Li Xuan coldly, with even more murderous intent in his eyes, "I don't care what your reasons are, it's a fact that you were ruthless."
"Since you have done something, you have to pay a price. Since you smashed Xiaochuan's mouth and lost one of his arms."
"Then if I smash your mouth and destroy your limbs, it shouldn't be too much, right?"
Wow——
As soon as this statement came out, the whole place was in an uproar.
Li Xuan couldn't help but narrow his eyes.
He held the mortal sword tightly with his right hand, and the spiritual energy in his body began to surge, and he was ready to use the forbidden technique.
There is no such thing as allowing a mermaid to be eaten. Even if he can't beat him, he will still do it.
Putting aside his past identity, Li Xuan is now considered a sword cultivator. As a sword cultivator, one would rather bend than bend and move forward indomitably, so why should there be any reason to bend down?
As Lin Changshan spoke, the aura of the powerful man in the Wheel Sea Realm exploded, and at the same time he waved his hand and slapped Li Xuan in the face.
The vast spiritual energy surged and set off a roaring sound. Even if it was just a casual palm from a strong person in the wheel sea realm, it was definitely not comparable to the innate one.
This was the territory of the Lin family. Li Xuan actually slapped Lin Chuan in front of everyone here and even disabled Lin Chuan's arm. Naturally, he couldn't bear this.
Otherwise, where is the majesty of the Lin family, one of the five major families? Wouldn't it become a laughing stock?
"Hahaha, Lin Changshan, you shameless bitch, you actually attacked a junior in front of everyone, you are so majestic!"
Just when Lin Changshan's attack was about to fall on Li Xuan, and Li Xuan was about to use the forbidden technique to fight with all his strength,
